description: Toolset declarations for the toolset x harness handoff matrix. A toolset is declared once and applied to N harnesses (pfylib/toolsets.py). Statuses are derived from what scripts/pfy_*_NNN.py actually wire today; do not inflate.

status_legend.implemented: plan() returns a complete apply plan: env + brief + a harness-native config surface already used in this repo (GROK_HOME/skills or config.toml, $PFY_STATE_DIR/opencode.json fragment, CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/CLAUDE.md). Covered by tests/.
status_legend.partial: env and/or $PFY_STATE_DIR brief only (PFY_ATTACH_AGENTS convention), or wired only under a condition (e.g. Axon CLI present). No harness-native surface written.
status_legend.stub: nothing wired for this harness; plan() returns STUB with a next step.

lanes_legend.local: runs against LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL / local binaries (ADR-0014 spine)
lanes_legend.cloud: requires a cloud key or subscription; subject to pfylib/hedge.py budget
